description: This Python source file defines the GeminiImageEditConfig class, which extends BaseImageEditConfig. It provides methods for configuring, validating, and transforming image edit requests specifically for the Gemini image editing model, including handling optional parameters, preparing image data, transforming responses, and URL construction.
